Rajasthan RSSB CET Senior Secondary Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Rajasthan RSSB CET Senior Secondary Online Form 2026. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 23/07/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 24/06/2026
  • Last Date : 23/07/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 23/07/2026
  • Correction Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Date : 23-25 October 2026
  • Exam City Available : As Per Schedule
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • Result Declared Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Name : RSSB CET 2026 Eligibility*

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 24/06/2026
  • Last Date : 23/07/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 23/07/2026
  • General / Other State : 600/-
  • EWS / OBC / SBC : Rs.400/- for Rajasthan Candidates
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 400/-for Rajasthan Candidates
  • Correction Fee : Rs. 300/-
  • Common Eligibility Test (CET) : Higher Secondary / Intermediate Passed from any Recognized Board in India. More Details Read the Notification

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
